pattern: no limit on liability|unlimited liability|liability shall not be limited|without limit
rationale: The contract exposes the party to unlimited financial liability with no cap.
recommendation: Negotiate an aggregate liability cap (e.g. fees paid or a fixed amount).

pattern: liability cap.*(?:5|10|15|25)%|liability.*limited to.*(?:fees paid|six months|one month)
rationale: The liability cap may be disproportionately low relative to potential damages.
recommendation: Align the cap with contract value and risk exposure.

rationale: Consequential damages exclusion may be absent or narrowed.
recommendation: Ensure mutual exclusion of consequential and indirect damages.

pattern: indemnif.*(?:by vendor|by supplier|by contractor)|vendor.*shall indemnif|supplier.*agrees to indemnif
rationale: Indemnity obligations appear one-sided against one party.
recommendation: Request mutual indemnification to balance risk.

pattern: indemnif.*(?:any and all|all claims|arising out of or in connection with)
rationale: Indemnity scope is unusually broad covering unlimited claims.
recommendation: Narrow indemnity to third-party IP and negligence claims.

rationale: Expected indemnification clause not detected for this agreement type.
recommendation: Add standard indemnification provisions.

rationale: Party lacks a termination-for-convenience right.
recommendation: Add termination for convenience with notice period.

rationale: Termination notice period may be excessive and lock in the party.
recommendation: Shorten notice period or add early-exit milestones.

rationale: Payments may be forfeited unfairly upon termination.
recommendation: Clarify refund rights for unused services.

rationale: Automatic renewal may lock the party in without active consent.
recommendation: Add advance notice and opt-out rights before renewal.

rationale: No renewal mechanism defined for the agreement term.
recommendation: Define renewal terms and conditions.

rationale: High late-payment interest or penalty rate.
recommendation: Cap late payment interest to a reasonable statutory rate.

rationale: Large upfront payments before delivery create risk.
recommendation: Align payment to milestones and acceptance.

rationale: Automatic payment debits require strict controls.
recommendation: Ensure prior written authorization for auto-debit.

rationale: Personal data may be transferred across borders without safeguards.
recommendation: Add SCCs or DPDP/GDPR compliant transfer mechanisms.

rationale: Indian DPDP Act obligations not reflected in contract.
recommendation: Include DPDP-compliant data processing terms.

rationale: Data breach liability and notification duties unclear.
recommendation: Define breach notification SLA and liability allocation.

rationale: Governing law may be unfavorable or inconvenient for Indian parties.
recommendation: Negotiate Indian governing law or arbitration seat in India.

rationale: No governing law or jurisdiction clause detected.
recommendation: Add governing law and exclusive jurisdiction clause.

rationale: Arbitration seat outside India may increase dispute costs.
recommendation: Consider arbitration seated in India for cost efficiency.

rationale: Injunctive relief terms may be one-sided.
recommendation: Balance equitable relief rights between parties.

rationale: No audit or inspection rights clause detected.
recommendation: Add reasonable audit and books-and-records rights.

pattern: audit.*(?:within 30 days|30 days of|limited to 1 year)
rationale: Audit window may be too short for compliance reviews.
recommendation: Extend audit window to at least 3 years.

rationale: No force majeure clause detected exposing the party to uncontrollable events.
recommendation: Add force majeure covering pandemic, cyber events and government actions.

pattern: assignment.*(?:consent of|prior written consent).*(?:not be unreasonably)
rationale: Assignment restriction may block legitimate corporate restructuring.
recommendation: Allow assignment to affiliates and on change of control.

rationale: Non-compete scope may be overbroad or unenforceable.
recommendation: Narrow non-compete to defined territory, duration and scope.

rationale: Non-compete surviving the term may be excessive under Indian law.
recommendation: Cap post-termination non-compete duration and scope.

rationale: No warranty clause detected for services or deliverables.
recommendation: Add express warranties for services and deliverables.

rationale: Insurance coverage may not meet standard liability thresholds.
recommendation: Specify minimum insurance limits and proof of coverage.

rationale: IP ownership/assignment not clearly defined for deliverables.
recommendation: Add IP assignment and residual rights clause.

rationale: Party may retain insufficient rights to its own background IP.
recommendation: Ensure mutual background IP licenses.

rationale: Open-source obligations may create copyleft exposure.
recommendation: Review OSS usage and ensure license compliance.

rationale: No compliance warranty for applicable laws and regulations.
recommendation: Add compliance representation and warranty.

rationale: Anti-bribery terms present but may lack audit remedies.
recommendation: Add termination rights on bribery breach.

rationale: Service-level credits or remedies may be absent.
recommendation: Define service credits and escalation remedies.

rationale: Deliverables or SOW left undefined.
recommendation: Attach detailed statement of work before signing.

rationale: Contractual notice mechanism may be limited to informal channels.
recommendation: Require written notice with deemed-receipt rules.

pattern: confidential.*(?:for a period of|for two|for three) years
rationale: Confidentiality obligations may expire too soon.
recommendation: Extend confidentiality term or make it perpetual.

rationale: Confidentiality carve-outs may be overly broad.
recommendation: Ensure carve-outs protect trade secrets.

rationale: Publicity/reference rights may allow unsolicited use of party name.
recommendation: Restrict reference use and require prior approval.
